status: unadopted; native/runtime accounting and containment unqualified
scope: One original transaction epoch; every compatible Truss assembly shares the ledger. Host native stack depth is independently admitted.

accounting.creation: Charge an attempt and consume the unique name counter before possible native submission; unknown creation retains its outstanding slot. Refused pre-submission attempts consume no native-depth slot.
accounting.commands: Every native control submission charges allControlSubmissions and exactly one normal or reserved-cleanup counter, including failed/unknown controls. Total and category limits apply simultaneously; no refund after rollback, release or cleanup.
accounting.depth: Admit observed host plus Truss stack before creation; a Truss-only count cannot prove native depth. Unknown host stack depth refuses this finite profile.
accounting.cleanup: Before each new creation reserve one qualified rollback-to and one release allowance plus their exact bounded transport/work/storage costs. Existing ancestor/descendant cleanup reservations remain owned until confirmed invalidation. Reserved cleanup is separate from normal admission and cannot finance new work. Each created boundary owns at most two single-use cleanup command permits; consuming one never replenishes it. After cleanup, a retained target without sufficient cleanup reserve cannot admit new dependent work until separately charged replacement reserves pass the same cumulative/total limits. Resource reservations stay inside the shared peak/cumulative/work ledger, not extra budgets.
accounting.bytes: Charge full private record, indexes, name and original evidence copies; 512 is a selected implementation ceiling to prove, not a measured object-size assertion. Payload release does not invalidate retained external handles by itself.
accounting.failure: Normal-cap exhaustion closes new control admission but preserves already-reserved cleanup and original recovery. Cleanup cannot be submitted without original transaction usability/ordering; uncertainty retains quarantine rather than spending permits blindly.
